hook: Today we are having a picnic!
But my friends are all hiding!
episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

finds.action_line: The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?

gag_lines: Come out, come out, little friend!
finds.action_line: The frog can hop! Can you hop too?
The bird can flap! Can you flap too?

gag_lines: Hmm? I do not see anyone.
finds.action_line: The duck can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?
The cat can spin! Can you spin too?
The cow can dance! Can you dance too?
The chick can hop! Can you hop too?

lines: Let us hop and clap hands now,
Stomp your feet and then spin,
Wave your arms wiggle with me,
Flap your wings and jump up high,
Stretch your arms and dance and wiggle,

finale: Thank you for finding all my friends!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
